questions.q: Write isEven(int n) returning true if n is even.
questions.model: public static boolean isEven(int n) { return n % 2 == 0; }

questions.q: Write void average(String path) that prints the average of numbers in a file; handle exceptions.
questions.model: try (Scanner sc = new Scanner(new FileReader(path))) { int sum=0,n=0; while(sc.hasNextInt()){sum+=sc.nextInt();n++;} System.out.println(n==0?0:(double)sum/n); } catch (FileNotFoundException e) { System.out.println("Not found"); }

questions.q: Two differences between Statement and PreparedStatement.
questions.model: PreparedStatement uses ? placeholders, prevents SQL injection, is precompiled and faster when reused; Statement sends a raw SQL string.

questions.q: C1: Vehicle (brand, constructor, describe() returns "Vehicle"); Car and Bike override describe(); in main store both in a Vehicle[] and print brand + describe(). Explain why output differs.
questions.model: class Vehicle{ protected String brand; Vehicle(String b){brand=b;} String describe(){return "Vehicle";} } class Car extends Vehicle{ Car(String b){super(b);} @Override String describe(){return "Car";} } class Bike extends Vehicle{ Bike(String b){super(b);} @Override String describe(){return "Bike";} } Vehicle[] v={new Car("Toyota"),new Bike("BMX")}; for(Vehicle x:v) System.out.println(x.brand+" "+x.describe()); // the real object decides (runtime polymorphism)

questions.q: C2: Swing window with JTextField, Search button and result JLabel; method using PreparedStatement to select a student's name by id; connect them, handle not found.
questions.model: JFrame f=new JFrame("Find Student"); JTextField t=new JTextField(10); JButton b=new JButton("Search"); JLabel r=new JLabel(""); JPanel p=new JPanel(); p.add(t);p.add(b);p.add(r); f.add(p); b.addActionListener(e->{ String n=find(Integer.parseInt(t.getText())); r.setText(n==null?"Not found":n); }); // find(): SELECT name FROM students WHERE id=? with ps.setInt(1,id); rs.next()?rs.getString("name"):null
